speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing agitation, yellowing of your skin and eyes, and abnormal lab results; can you tell me if you have been feeling unusually fatigued or nauseated recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely Hepatitis B or C given sexual history and substance use). The combination of agitation, jaundice, and risk factors strongly suggests acute viral hepatitis, possibly complicated by drug-induced liver injury. I will request liver function tests and viral serologies to confirm.
